pieces.Text: Your druid level is treated as two higher if you take the form of a snake, while your druid level is treated as two lower if you take on any form other than a snake.  In addition, when activating this ability, you can expend a daily use of your serpent's bite ability to either increase the damage dice of any bite attack gained from wild shape as if a creature one size category larger, or instead use the bite damage from your serpent's bite ability and increase the DC of any poison attacks by +2.
